definition: a wide street in a town
description: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.

de.answer: Sie winkt auf der Avenue ein Taxi heran.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está parando un taxi en la avenida.
